action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gnoll makes one Bite attack and two Bone Flail attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the gnoll's next turn.

bonus.name: Rampage (2/Day)
entries: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the gnoll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it makes one Bite attack.
